categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in three primary business segments: (1) Semiconductor display intelligent equipment - including binding, lamination, and detection equipment for TFT-LCD, OLED, and Mini/Micro LED displays; (2) Automotive intelligent cockpit system equipment - assembly and testing equipment for vehicle display systems; (3) Semiconductor packaging and testing equipment - including die bonding machines and related equipment; and (4) Lithium battery equipment - including module assembly and pack line automation equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs self-developed core technologies including: precision bonding technology for large-size and flexible OLED/foldable screens, lamination technology for automotive multi-screen displays, high-precision dispensing and visual inspection technology, Mini/Micro LED chip sorting and mass transfer technology, and semiconductor die bonding processes (eutectic, soft solder, flip-chip). Manufacturing uses flexible small-batch production with self-production of core components and outsourcing of non-core parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include leading display panel manufacturers (BOE, Visionox, Tianma, Huaxing Optoelectronics), automotive electronics suppliers (Continental, Bosch, Visteon), and lithium battery manufacturers (CATL, BYD). End markets include smartphones, tablets, automotive displays, VR/AR/MR devices, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major presence in South China, East China, Central China, and West China regions. International operations include a subsidiary in Romania (LIANDE EQUIPMENT S.R.L) serving European markets, with additional presence in Southeast Asia and North America through partnerships with global customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the supply chain as an equipment manufacturer. It supplies production equipment to downstream display panel manufacturers, automotive electronics suppliers, and battery manufacturers, while sourcing components and materials from upstream suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing into mid-stage display equipment manufacturing to reduce reliance on Japanese and Korean competitors; (2) expanding semiconductor packaging and testing equipment capabilities including advanced packaging and third-generation semiconductor equipment; (3) accelerating lithium battery equipment development with focus on automation and intelligence; (4) increasing R&D investment (10% of revenue) and talent acquisition; (5) pursuing international market expansion and establishing overseas service networks.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized equipment to manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of equipment after installation, debugging, and acceptance. The company also generates revenue from spare parts, maintenance services, and technical support. Sales are predominantly direct with minimal use of distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In display equipment, the company competes with Japanese and Korean manufacturers in mid-to-downstream processes where it maintains leading domestic position. In semiconductor equipment, it competes in packaging and testing segments with growing market share. In lithium battery equipment, it competes with established Chinese manufacturers. The company differentiates through domestic cost advantages, faster service response, and customization capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2023 revenue of RMB 1.207 billion (23.8% YoY growth), net profit of RMB 177.3 million (130.5% YoY growth), and total assets of RMB 3.037 billion. The company demonstrates strong growth trajectory with expanding margins, driven by increased market demand for display and battery equipment, successful product diversification, and improved operational efficiency.
